title: Cover Letter Artifact
description: Schema-typed cover-letter artifact emitted to apply-pack/<slug>/cover-letter.json

body.description: Full cover letter body as plain prose (markdown). No greeting/sign-off included — those are in their own fields.

greeting.description: Opening greeting line, e.g. 'Dear Hiring Team,'

word_count.description: Word count of the body field

short_pitch.description: 1-2 sentence elevator pitch usable in email subject or LinkedIn message

notes_for_candidate.description: Agent notes about editing suggestions or risk flags (not shown to employer)

ai_detection_score.description: Pangram / GPTZero AI detection score (0-1, lower = more human-like). Null if not checked.

risk_band.description: Overall AI-detection risk for the whole letter
